==About==

A {{i|Blue Potato}} is the product of a second tier {{i|Any Potato}} Harvest. Right-clicking a Blue Potato and selecting "Split' will divide your Blue Potato into 6x {{i|Potato Chunk}}s. A Blue Potato can be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a {{i|Baked Potato}} or boiled in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}} to produce a {{i|Boiled Potato}}.
